note: Every case is pinned to one mainnet block, so replaying it asks Chain MCP the same questions and must get the same position, health factor and alert. Nothing is sent to anyone but the console.

cases.label: A $1.5M USDC loan against syzUSD, a hair above liquidation

alert.headline: CRITICAL: health factor 1.0134 (warn at 1.3, critical at 1.1)
alert.action: repay 336,001.9336 USDC or add 437,713.0043 syzUSD of collateral to get back to a health factor of 1.30.
lines: Collateral 1,547,470.9011 syzUSD worth 1,687,707.0967 USDC; debt 1,523,888.0824 USDC; liquidation threshold (LLTV) 91.5%; current loan-to-value 90.29%.

Even at a flat price, interest at 9.35% a year takes about 51.8 days to get there.
